summary: Iter318 — Frontend-only render verification of (1) Driver /encaisser (contactless receive), (2) /pay entry (contactless pay), (3) admin parity fix /admin/restricted vs /admin/geo-fence. All 3 pages render correctly and the restricted-zones page is now visually distinct from the full geofence page.

After submitting 12.50 €, backend returned a request -> QR card (receive-qr-card), QRCodeSVG (receive-qr), 6-digit code (receive-code='963877'), displayed amount '12.50 €', countdown 'expire dans 14:56', Nouveau/Annuler buttons all present. End-to-end contactless creation via POST /api/contactless/requests succeeded from the UI.

data-testid=contactless-pay-entry rendered. Title 'Payer un commerçant'. 'Scanner le QR code' button (pay-scan-btn) + 6-digit input (pay-code-input) + 'Continuer' button (pay-code-submit) all present. No crash.

data-testid=admin-restricted-zones is present (admin-geofence is NOT). H1 page heading 'Zones réglementées'. Subtitle '2 zone(s) réglementée(s) — circulation/prise en charge restreinte'. Only restricted zones shown: ['Zone Restreinte Test','Hyper-centre piéton'] (2 rows). CTA renamed to 'Ajouter une zone réglementée'.

data-testid=admin-geofence is present (admin-restricted-zones is NOT). H1 'Geo Fence Locations'. Subtitle '5 zones configurees'. Full list shown: ['Paris Centre','Fort-de-France','Aeroport CDG','Zone Restreinte Test','Hyper-centre piéton']. CTA 'Ajouter une zone'. Two pages are visibly distinct as required.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminGeoFence still uses local React useState seed data (5 hardcoded zones). When /admin/restricted creates a new restricted zone via 'Ajouter', the new zone is only in the restricted page's local state — it will NOT appear in /admin/geo-fence (and vice versa) since both routes mount separate component instances. If product expects shared persistence, lift state to a context or persist to the backend.
Minor: in AdminGeoFence.js the unused import `Circle` from '@phosphor-icons/react' is still present (already noted in earlier iterations) — dead import.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 routes render with correct testids/titles/content; 0 pageerrors)
